input_template:
Information need and questions to answer: ...
Inclusion criteria: ...
Exclusion criteria: ...
Candidate text: ...
Boundaries of supplied material (complete candidate, excerpt, title, or snippet): ...

questions.name: relevance
questions.instructions: Judge only the supplied candidate against the explicit information need and inclusion and exclusion criteria. Treat supporting evidence and counterevidence as relevant. Clearly_irrelevant requires positive evidence that this supplied material contributes nothing to any stated question. Missing criteria, unclear boundaries, or conflicting evidence require insufficient_context. Classify only the supplied material; a title or excerpt never establishes that unseen source content is irrelevant. A skip avoids only further summarization or synthesis of this candidate, never retrieval or required source inspection.

choices.description: The supplied candidate can contribute evidence, including counterevidence, to the stated information need.
Positive evidence establishes that the supplied candidate falls outside the information need and contributes no relevant evidence.
Missing or conflicting context prevents a supported relevance judgment.
